tei:div.tei:p: 305) ༄༅/ chu gtor shin tu rgyas pa nyams su blang ba'i thabs yid bzhin snying po ces bya ba bzhugs so/ 306) na mo gu ru/

chu gtor gyi rim pa shin tu bsdus pa la spro na/ gtor rdzas rnams legs par bshams la/ dang po skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kun gtso bla ma la// bdag sogs rtag par skyabs su mchi// mkha' khyab 'gro la phan phyir du// byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// sdig bshags dge la yi rang ngo*// mya ngan mi 'da' chos 'khor bskul// dge kun byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ gnas dang bdag dang mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dhā sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wā shud+dha nyahaṃ/ sa gzhi gnas khang rin chen gyi// skyes tshal gzhal yas nyams dga' bar// bdag nyid 'phags mchog mdzes 'dzum dkar// mchod sbyin me tog longs sku'i tshul// rigs bdag snang mtha'i dbu rgyan cing*// stong gsal 'ja' 'od skur bzhugs gyur// om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ ting 'dzin smon lam las grub pa'i// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// nam mkha' rab 'byams yongs khyab cing*// 308) zag med rgyal ba mnyes par gyur// na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛ h+ṇe daṃ ba l+yī di swā hā/ mgron spyan drangs shing khrus gsol mchod 'bul ni/ bdag nyid thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// dkon mchog sri zhu yon tan dang*// ris drug bgegs rigs lan chags sogs// mgron kun spyan drangs bzhugs par gyur/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ye shes bdud rtsi dag pa'i chus// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus gsol zhing*// dri med mchod tshogs rgya mtsho yis// rab 'byams rgyal ba mnyes par gyur// sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ bdag gis de ring skyobs pa thams cad kyi// ces sogs nas/ sems can rnams la bde 'byor shog

ces pa'i bar bya'o/ ༈ de nas gtor ma brgya rtsa bshams la/ rim pa ltar re re bzhin du byin brlab dang gzungs sngags bzla zhing 309) bcu tshan bzhi pa la ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis kyang mchod/ lnga pa man la de bzhin bshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan bsgrags par bya'o/ dang po byin rlabs ni/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ om̐ swā bha = rin chen gtor snod rgya chen du// gtor rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchog ci 'dod dgyes pa skongs byed pa'i// 'dod 'byung longs spyod chen por gyur// om̐ āḥhūm̐/ ces lan gcig dang*/ na ma s+sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te om̐ saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra hūm̐/ lan bcu re bzlas/ bcu tshan dang po la/ rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba'i tshogs// sprul 'khor bcas la mchod bgyis pas// bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus la// thugs rjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gnyis pa la/ yi daṃ zhi khro ḍak+ki'i tshogs// chos skyongs bsrung mar bcas la 'bul// mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol zhing*/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las grub par mdzod// gsum pa ni/ lha mi'i drang srong rigs sngags 'chang*// bden 310) tshig grub pa rnams la 'bul// 'jig rten khams kun bde legs kyi// yon tan 'byung bar mdzad du gsol// bzhi pa ni/ nor skyong dngos grub ster ba'i lha// dzam+la'i rigs sogs kun la 'bul/ chos dang mthun pa'i 'dod dgu yis// bdag sogs re ba skong bar mdzod// lnga pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la = de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la= de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten legs skyong zhing*// ston pa'i dam chos bsrung ba yi// lha klu mthu ldan rnams la 'bul// bstan pa skyong bar mdzad du gsol// drug pa ni/ stong gsum 'jig rten bod khams la// dbang bsgyur dkar phyogs skyong ba'i rigs// gzhi bdag gnas bdag kun la 'bul// chos ldan gdong grogs mdzad du gsol//

bdun pa ni/ sde brgyad 'byung po dregs pa'i rigs// nad bdag gdon bgegs ma lus kun// gtor ma bdud rtsis 311) tshim byos la// gzhan la gnod dang 'tshe ba spong*/ brgyad pa ni/ 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa yi// drin can ris drug pha ma kun// mchod sbyin ci 'dod longs spyod kyis// tshim zhing byang chu myur thob shog dgu pa ni/ ma dag ser sna'i las sgrib can// bkres skom yi dwags 'gro ba kun// ci 'dod bzang btung longs spyod cing*// sgrib bral bde chen thob par shog / bcu pa ni/ tshe rabs kun gyi lan chags dang*// bu lon dkor gyi sgrib pa sogs// ci mchis sbyin pa 'dis 'khor te// ma lus rdzogs pa'i byang chub shog / de nas lha gtor bshams la/ byin gyis brlabs cing*/ gzungs tshar brgyad dang mtshan bsgrag la/ blo bur lhags dang nyam chung gi mgron rigs lhag la dbang ba rnams// bshal chu'i gtor ma 'dis tshim nas/ /bla med go 'phang thob gyur cig de nas chu sbyin ni/ gtor snod lnga'am gcig tu chu gtsang sbrengs la dang por/ 'phags pa 312)spyan ras gzigs dbang gi phyag nas 'bebs pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshims byas shing*/ khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog / gnyis pa ni/ om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bzhi par/ om̐ dza la yi daṃ sarba pre ta bh+ya swā hā/ lnga par / rang nyid mi 'khrug pa ru gyur/ na mo rat+na trā yā ya/ om̐ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pā ro sa rā ṇi me/ sarba satwa nañca swā hā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// ces sogs bden tshig brjod/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// sogs kyi chos sbyin bya'o/ ༈ de nas mchod gsol dang gshegs gsol bsngo smon shis brjod ni/ sngags dang ting 'dzin yo byad kyi// lhag chad nor 'khrul ci mchis rnams// mthol bshags bzod par bzhes nas kyang*// mgron rnams rang rang gnas su gshegs// badz+ra muḥsarba bhu ta ghats+tsha/

dge ba 'dis mtshon tshe rabs kyi/ /dge kun gcig 313) tu bsdoms nas ni// 'gro kun rnam mkhyen rgyur bsngo ba'i// smon lam ci btab 'grub gyur cig bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la// mkha' 'gro chos srung byin rlabs kyis// bkra shis dge legs char chen rgyus// phyogs dus kun du 'bab par shog ces pa 'di ni/ gang zag shin tu spros pa chung ba rnams la phan phyir/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis mkha' 'gro'i gnas chen dpal gyi rgod tshang phug tu bkod pa dge'o/ bkra shis stsol/ 314)
